sloka: प्रकृत्या निपुणः चैव बुद्धिमान् चैव वानरः ।न अपरीक्षित वीर्येण सुग्रीवः सख्यम् एष्यति ॥४-१५-१४॥
transliteration: prakṛtyā nipuṇaḥ caiva buddhimān caiva vānaraḥ ।na aparīkṣita vīryeṇa sugrīvaḥ sakhyam eṣyati ॥4-15-14॥

translations.english: 'Sugriva is clever by nature. He is wise. Without assessing the ability of the ally he will not enter into friendship.
